decisions.reason: As a home-page product that extends the core cloud messaging platform, it appears strategically important, validated early, and inexpensive to keep relative to its option value in a growing market.
This service fits the firm's digital workflow direction and already showed concrete customer adoption, so uncertainty has resolved favorably and supports continued commercialization.
Although fax-related services face longer-run substitution risk, this bridge between email and fax still complements regulated multi-channel communications and is likely cheap to maintain.
As a close-in optimization feature for an established fax business, it likely has low carrying cost and helps defend the value of the broader messaging portfolio.

Threat protection is a strong fit with the firm's secure-communications positioning, and despite some portfolio-pruning risk after other security experiments, it still looks worth keeping as an option.
